highlights.title: Every source knows the same article
highlights.description: Web articles, ebooks, PDFs, and text imports now share an explicit source identity, so translations, reading progress, and annotations stay attached when content changes entry points.

highlights.title: Assistant tasks stay coherent
highlights.description: Streaming work for verification, annotations, and follow-ups stays in the window that started it, while model selection remains bounded so long tasks do not cross wires.

highlights.title: Large libraries open lighter
highlights.description: The catalog is paged and reading and assistant indexes are reused. The more books and longer texts you have, the more noticeable the difference is at startup and search.

highlights.title: PDF selections stay put while you scroll
highlights.description: Selections remain attached to their text as you scroll through a PDF, and imported text appears in the Library immediately without a restart.

highlights.title: Imports and sync recover more gracefully
highlights.description: Text and Kindle imports are bounded, and reading progress, logs, source changes, and credential replacement retain recoverable state after a failure.
